question.text:
The number of metals that show passivity with concentrate HNO3 among
Cr, Fe, Ni, Cu, Zn, Al, Ag, Sn

solution.text: <math><mi mathvariant="\"normal\"">C</mi><mi mathvariant="\"normal\"">r</mi><mo>,</mo><mi mathvariant="\"normal\""></mi><mi mathvariant="\"normal\"">F</mi><mi mathvariant="\"normal\"">e</mi><mo>,</mo><mi mathvariant="\"normal\""></mi><mi mathvariant="\"normal\"">N</mi><mi mathvariant="\"normal\"">i</mi></math> and <math><mi mathvariant="\"normal\"">A</mi><mi mathvariant="\"normal\"">l</mi></math> react with conc. <math><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="\"normal\"">H</mi><mi mathvariant="\"normal\"">N</mi><mi mathvariant="\"normal\"">O</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>3</mn></mrow></msub></math> to form a protective oxide layer which protest the metal surface from further reaction.
